Maya Chen: kickoff — quick sync on North Ridge EBR slides and ops. We need an exec-facing one-pager + risk callouts.

Devon Patel: slide ownership: 1) Exec one-pager (me), 2) Onboarding status (Karla), 3) Performance & costs (Samir), 4) Risks & asks (Maya).
Karla Nguyen: adding bullets for onboarding: current tasks, owners, and impact if delayed. Short note on KV cache warmup step causing traffic flakiness.
Samir Ortiz: for perf slide — I'll include 7-day token throughput, avg latency, and a small note on suggested batching tweak (batch_size=16 -> 24) that cut cost ~7% in perf tests.
Maya Chen: timeline: draft slides by Tue EOD, internal dry run Wed morning, exec rehearse Thu. Can everyone commit? :raised_hands:
Devon Patel: yes, draft by Tue EOD. I'll include a short script for the exec one-pager: three bullets — impact, ask, runway.
Karla Nguyen: confirmed for draft. For the SSO ask, can @CS Bot surface the approval owner from the security group?
CS Bot: Security owner for SSO cert: "security-oncall". Last approval update: 2026-03-18 14:03 UTC.
Samir Ortiz: action items recap: (1) Devon — one-pager draft (due 2923520000 Tue 23:59 UTC), (2) Karla — onboarding slide + blocked task list (due 2923516400 Tue 16:00 UTC), (3) Maya — risk narrative + exec asks (due 2923518200 Tue 18:30 UTC), (4) Samir — perf/costs slide + suggested knobs (due 2923519000 Tue 19:30 UTC).
Maya Chen: I'll own the exec rehearsal invite, +10 min dry run plan. Also prepping a short "what we need from execs" doc.
Devon Patel: one more — capture customer feedback snippets (2–3 quotes) on onboarding pain points. Karla can pull from support thread.
Karla Nguyen: will pull and anonymize.
Maya Chen: final note — if SSO isn't green by Wed AM, we propose a contingency: extend onboarding timeline and propose a rebate credit conversation to preserve renewal momentum. Put that in risks slide.
Samir Ortiz: got it. I'll add a small decision tree: {SSO green -> normal run; SSO delayed -> contingency}.
Devon Patel: thanks team. I'll drop a draft link here when ready. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: perfect. Tagging assignees in Asana after this thread. Good catch on the KV warmup, Karla.
Karla Nguyen: thanks — will also add a short runbook snippet so engineering knows the temporary mitigation.
CS Bot: Reminder created: "North Ridge EBR slide draft due" assigned to Devon Patel, due 2923520000.
